args: async page => { const tab=await page.context().newPage(); await tab.goto('https://wt.ioa.pub/registry/#/login'); await tab.getByRole('button',{name:'忘记密码',exact:true}).click(); return {url:tab.url(),title:await tab.title(),text:await tab.locator('body').innerText(),fields:await tab.locator('input').evaluateAll(nodes=>nodes.map(n=>({type:n.type,placeholder:n.placeholder,autocomplete:n.autocomplete}))) }; }
